seen: A tan dog asleep stretched flat out on a stone-tiled stoep under a tiled overhang, low golden light raking right across the tiles onto him. Beyond, a lush garden of palms and flowering shrubs, lawn, big terracotta pots, and a clean deep blue sky.
alreadyKept: He will move twice before lunch and both times by about a metre.

seen: A wide empty beach under a clean blue sky with a few wisps of cirrus. Two wooden Adirondack chairs and a small steel cooler box under a striped rainbow beach umbrella, facing a turquoise sea. Nobody sitting in them, no other people in the frame.

A farmhouse at dusk with a corrugated roof and a wide lit stoep. In the foreground a built-in stone fire pit where a man in an olive jumper is poking the fire and sending up a burst of sparks; another man stands beside him with a glass. On the lawn two barefoot boys are playing soccer. A clean gradient sky from orange at the horizon to deep blue with one bright planet out. Rolling hills behind.
alreadyKept: That fire was lit before anybody needed it, which is what a clear evening does.
Saturday, and the sky went from orange to blue without one cloud interrupting.

seen: A farmyard at night under a huge Milky Way. Two people lying in the open back of a white bakkie on sleeping bags, both with an arm up, pointing at the sky. A whitewashed farmhouse with one warm-lit window on the right, a kraal fence, a small fire away to the left, low hills.
alreadyKept: You have to drive two hours from anywhere to get a sky like that.
Saturday night, and the entertainment is free and about four billion years old.

seen: A high view over a city at night: deep blue sky with stars and a few small clouds catching moonlight, and below a broad carpet of city lights, office towers with lit signs, and tree-lined suburbs. Apartment rooftops in the foreground.

Three schoolchildren in white shirts and grey uniform walking along a paved pavement in low golden morning light, backpacks on, laughing at each other, their shadows stretched right across the paving. Modern white houses with timber slat fences, a young tree, mown lawn, and a flat-topped mountain already catching sun behind. Clean pale blue sky.
alreadyKept: Somewhere an estate agent is saying 'lifestyle'.

seen: A wide wet beach at sunrise, the whole sky filled with soft pink and gold mackerel cloud and mirrored perfectly in the wet sand. A lone surfer in a wetsuit walking towards the water with a board under his arm, small in the middle distance. Headland and sea mist on the left, low sun on the horizon.

A rooftop gathering in a city CBD under a hard deep-blue cloudless sky. Four people stand along the parapet with coffee cups, talking; two women sit on striped beach towels in the foreground, one pouring from a steel flask into a takeaway cup, both in sundresses and sunglasses, barefoot. A paperback, a bluetooth speaker and a tube of sunblock on the towel. Office towers all around.
alreadyKept: Days like this should come with a soundtrack.

seen: A father flat on his back on the lawn laughing with a small boy and a girl piled on top of him, all three laughing. A jacaranda in full purple flower overhead and fallen blossom all over the grass. A sandstone-clad house with a dark roof, white roses, lavender, and a hard clean blue sky.

A man in a blue shirt and khaki shorts reclining in a wooden deck chair on a paved patio, a beer bottle on the arm and an open magazine on his lap, giving the camera a small smug smile. Behind him a boy pushes an old green manual mower across a dry, patchy sun-bleached lawn. Red-brick double-storey house, jacaranda blossom on the paving, hard sunlight, deep blue sky.
alreadyKept: If you're working today, we feel sorry for you.

seen: Five office workers walking out through the revolving glass doors of a modern glass building into hard sunlight; the man in the blue blazer has both arms up in a double victory sign. Backpacks, tote bags, a briefcase. A street clock on the left, trees, pedestrians, and a deep blue cloudless sky reflected in the glass.
alreadyKept: Whoever booked the four o'clock meeting is going to be sitting in it alone.

seen: A hadeda standing on a dry straw-coloured suburban lawn, low angle, looking straight at camera down its long curved beak. Behind it a lawn sprinkler running with an arc of water catching the sun, a face-brick house with a tiled roof, clipped hedges, deep clean blue sky.

Poolside. A weathered wooden table in the foreground with a tall glass of iced tea sweating with condensation, a pair of tortoiseshell sunglasses folded beside it, and a straw hat on the lounger to the right. Beyond, a turquoise pool, sandstone paving, aloes and cycads, a palm, a palisade fence and hills in the distance under a deep clean blue sky. Nobody in the frame.
alreadyKept: Bottle this one. Open it in winter.

seen: Two young women in wetsuits sitting on the wall of a tidal pool at sunset, wet hair, bare feet dangling towards the water, towels folded on their laps, laughing at each other. A mountain across the bay in silhouette, glassy sea, peach and gold sky, their reflections perfect in the still pool.

A Karoo dorp street at dusk — Victorian houses with white broekie-lace verandahs, porch lights on, a windpomp silhouetted against a gold-to-purple gradient sky with one bright planet out. Four barefoot boys playing street cricket on the dirt road with a black wheelie bin for wickets. An elderly couple leaning on the garden wall watching them.

A man mowing a lawn at golden hour with a petrol mower, the low sun blazing through an olive tree on the left and throwing long stripes of shadow and light right across the grass. A flat-roofed concrete-and-timber house with big sliding doors, a laid dining table and pendant light visible inside. Ornamental grasses, clean pale sky.

A teenage boy riding a mountain bike hard through a bermed dirt corner, leaning into it and grinning, dust kicking up behind him and lit gold by the low sun. Fynbos on both sides, rolling hills and a distant valley behind, sky graduating from gold at the horizon to blue above.

Two small birds silhouetted side by side on a telephone wire against an enormous streaked pink and orange bushveld sunset. Below, a dirt road running away between acacias, low hills, dry grass and dust haze.

Three teenage boys walking away from camera down the middle of a quiet suburban street at dusk, arms around each other's shoulders, backpacks on. A street light already on to the left, a clean gradient sky from gold at the horizon to deep blue above, single-storey houses and palms, warm light on the walls.

Night. A tabby cat sitting upright on a moonlit lawn with its head turned up at the moon. To the right, the open sliding door of a modern concrete house with warm light inside, where a mother in pyjamas leans down beside a small boy in pyjamas who is pointing out at the sky. Bright moon top-left in a starry sky, garden uplights, palms, boundary wall.

A brass wall lantern glowing on a plastered wall at night with a big emperor moth settled on the wall beside it and several smaller insects on and around the glass. To the left a dark garden of aloes in a stone-walled bed, a thorny tree, and a deep blue sky full of stars.

A long wooden table in a garden at night under several strings of warm festoon lights, nine people seated along both sides eating and laughing — plates of steak and salad, beer bottles, bowls, and one phone lying face down on the table. Lush garden, trees, a brick retaining wall, deep blue night sky above the lights.

A row of nine kids in white soccer shirts, navy shorts and long navy socks with muddy boots, sitting along a kerb in golden late-afternoon light, all eating slap chips out of newspaper cones. Two kit bags on the pavement, a 1960s cream house with a blue fascia behind, hedge, palms, dry lawn.

A hadeda walking through a bed of dark turned soil, head down, long curved beak probing, right beside tall blue agapanthus in full flower. Green lawn beyond, trees, a white gabled house, deep blue sky.

A man walking up to the glass doors of a corporate office building, seen from behind, in a printed Hawaiian shirt, faded shorts and slip-slops with a messenger bag over his shoulder. Through the glass, people inside in shirts and ties. Deep blue sky and palms reflected in the glass.

A Johannesburg rooftop with Ponte and the Hillbrow Tower on the skyline. Two young women sit side by side on a folding bench under a striped beach umbrella, both barefoot with laptops open on their laps, working and smiling. A trestle table with potted plants and a mug, a cooler box on the concrete, beach towels laid out on the roof, hazy warm sky.

Two barefoot children playing catch on a green lawn in front of a white Cape Dutch farmhouse with dark shutters. A boy in a teal shirt is leaping into the air with both hands up for a yellow tennis ball; a girl in a white shirt and denim shorts runs laughing in the foreground. Restio grasses and fynbos beds, hard clean blue sky, short strong shadows.

A braai in a garden at golden hour. Two women at a built-in brick braai — one in a patterned apron holding the tongs, the other reaching over the grid — both laughing, with a coil of boerewors and a row of sausages on the grid and smoke rising. Behind them on the deck a man holds his head laughing and another holds a big bowl of salad. Coral and blue painted walls, aloes and pots, low sun through the trees.

A golden retriever lying flat out asleep on a sunlit wooden deck in full hard sun. Behind it a built-in stone braai with wood stacked underneath, a bench along a cream wall, a metal patio table and chairs, yuccas and pot plants, a strip of lawn, and an enormous empty deep-blue sky filling the top two thirds of the frame.

Early light in a suburban garden. A man in a short-sleeved shirt watering the lawn with a hose, coffee mug in his other hand, jacaranda overhead dropping purple, a Weber kettle braai on the patio, low house with lit windows.
